title: Canonical finite evaluation of the strict scalar mate
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, finite extensions $E,F$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, a $\mathbf Q_\ell$-algebra map $i:E\to F$, and the associated integral rings $A,B$ with uniformizers $t,v$. Fix a ramification index $e\ge1$ with $(t)B=(v^e)$ [def-pur-finite-compact-support-scalar-data]. Let $c=(j,p)$ compactify a scheme map $X\to Y$, let $S,S^\prime$ be the given derived reduction-system calculi, and let $M$ be any object of the derived category of completed $E$-coefficient module sheaves on $X$ [def-coef-derived-system-calculus-data]. Use precisely the strict arrow and source/target evaluation identifications of [def-pur-strict-scalar-mate-evaluation-data]. At each index $n\ge0$, evaluation of this arrow followed by the target identification equals the source identification followed by restriction to constant $B$-coefficients of the finite tensor map at exponents $n+1$ and $e(n+1)$. The finite tensor map is the finite proper scalar mate followed by proper direct image of the finite open tensor comparison [def-pur-finite-compact-support-scalar-data]. No invertibility assertion or quotient-transition assertion is included.

proof.text: Write arrow.app M as a ≫ b, where a is scalar extension of supportModel followed by the geometric proper/open scalar mate, and b is ramifiedImageBalancing. Expand whiskering and reassociate to prove this equality.
Functoriality of evaluation gives ev(a ≫ b)=ev(a)≫ev(b). Replace ev(b) followed by targetEvaluation using ramifiedImageBalancing_finiteEvaluation.
Apply geometricScalar_finiteEvaluation to the remaining ev(a) followed by scalarImageEvaluation. Its right side is exactly sourceEvaluation followed by restriction of finiteTensorMap.

lean.statement:
theorem strictScalarMate_finiteEvaluation
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} (c : Compactification f)
    (S : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus.{u, u} l E X)
    (S' : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus.{u, u} l F X) (e : ℕ)
    (he : PurCompactSupport.Ramification l E F i e) (hepos : 1 ≤ e)
    (M : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource l E X)) :
    ∀ n : ℕ,
        (ev (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l F)) Y n).map
            ((arrow l E F i c S S' e he hepos).app M) ≫
            (targetEvaluation l E F i c S' e he hepos n).hom.app M =
          (sourceEvaluation l E F i c S e he hepos n).hom.app M ≫
            (positiveRestriction l F Y (e * (n + 1))
              (Nat.mul_pos hepos (Nat.le_add_left 1 n))).map
              (PurCompactSupport.finiteTensorMap l E F i e he hepos n c M)
